description: This file defines a final Java class 'LoanSchedulePlanRepaymentPeriod' that models a period within a loan repayment schedule, including various financial amounts and period dates. It implements the 'LoanSchedulePlanPeriod' interface and uses Lombok's @Data annotation for boilerplate code generation.

classes.name: LoanSchedulePlanRepaymentPeriod
classes.description: A data class representing a repayment period in a loan schedule with period details and financial amounts.
